confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer estimates use current citywide crowd-sourced prices as a near-window proxy for July 2026. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from their local price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a broader July estimate and carries more uncertainty; no live listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator used; treated as a large Greek regional city with student demand and summer tourism, below Greek island-resort lodging prices.
